summary.tldr: Prohibits importing goods made wholly or partly in Xinjiang, China, under the Customs Tariff.
what_it_does: Prohibits the importation of goods manufactured or produced wholly or in part in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China.
Amends the Customs Tariff to add a new rule on prohibited imports.
Brings the Act into force on the first anniversary of royal assent.
summary.background: It amends the Customs Tariff by adding a new section on prohibited imports.
